definitions.title: Sum of an Infinite Series
definitions.statement: An infinite series converges to sum S if its sequence of partial sums {s_k} converges to S. If the sequence of partial sums diverges, the series diverges.
conditions: Partial sums s_k are finite for each k
definitions.explanation: Transforms an infinite addition into a limit of finite sums.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Series convergence means convergence of partial sums.

definitions.title: Geometric Series Theorem
definitions.statement: A geometric series with first term a and common ratio r converges if and only if |r| < 1, with sum a/(1 - r). If |r| >= 1 and a != 0, the series diverges.
definitions.explanation: One of the few series whose exact sum can be computed in closed form directly.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Geometric series converges iff |r| < 1, sum = a / (1 - r).

definitions.title: The nth-Term Test for Divergence
definitions.statement: If the limit of terms a_n is not zero, or if the limit does not exist, the series sum a_n diverges.
definitions.explanation: The converse is FALSE: a_n -> 0 does NOT guarantee convergence (e.g., Harmonic series sum 1/n diverges even though 1/n -> 0).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Terms must approach 0 to have any hope of converging.
